***BEWARE***

A media forum calling itself “OPTICS Politics” has been flooding various platforms with content that defies reason and common sense. My doubts began when it published pieces portraying Rodrigo Duterte as a “prisoner of conscience” and Orly Guteza as a credible witness, despite the glaring inconsistencies and fraudulent nature of his testimony. It even went so far as to brand Martin Romualdez “guilty” based solely on unverified claims from DDS circles.

After closer examination and thorough research, I discovered that ‘OPTICS Politics’ isn’t a registered media or news organization — not in the same league as legitimate outlets like CNN, Manila Standard, Fox News, or Manila Times. In truth, it’s nothing more than a propaganda forum used by DDS supporters to peddle distorted narratives, sow confusion, and keep the Duterte myth alive.

DAPAT BANG IMBESTIGAHAN NG ICI ANG NAIA?

Na-curious ako dito sa legal case na sinampa sa Supreme Court about the NAIA Public-Private Partnership (PPP) deal.

Nakaka intriga kasi yung lumabas na balita na nag remit ang Ramon Ang NAIA group ng 57 Billion Pesos to the government after one year of operations - compared to the 32 Billion Pesos remitted by the Manila Airport Authority over three decades or thirty (30) years!

So chineck ko din bakit gusto nila kasuhan sa ICI yung deal eh PPP naman eto, not necessarily an infrastructure project na itatayo.

So I checked the claims and here's what I found (I also consulted other lawyers and non-lawyers who are experts in PPP and the new procurement law):

❌ CLAIM

“The P1.5-Trillion NAIA PPP bears the hallmarks of scandal-ridden public works with unmistakable signs of corruption and tailor-fitted provisions.”

✅ REALITY

The NAIA PPP was not negotiated, it was competitively bid out by the Department of Transportation (DOTr) and PPP Center with ADB as independent transaction advisor.

All terms were set by government, not by any bidder. Ramon Ang's NNIC won on the strength of its offer, which gave the highest revenue share to government at 82.16 percent and met all technical and financial qualifications.

❌ CLAIM

“No major improvements can be seen, only new and excessive airport fees.”

✅ REALITY

Sa isang taon pa lang, andami na ang na-invest ng NNIC ni Ramon Ang sa NAIA like new chillers, feeders, and substations with Meralco.

Siempre andyan yung bagong Food Court sa NAIA Terminal 3 na mukhang modern and malawak.

I was at the airport a few months ago and refurbished na yung terminal interiors, better and easier to connect na sa free Wi-Fi, and mas maayos ang immigration queuing.

Ok na ok din ang parking system ngayon. Automated tapos may centralized TNVS hub and pansin ko mas maayos ang flow ng traffic sa NAIA terminals.

So in fairness, madami na nag bago.

❌ CLAIM

“Higher airport fees will burden passengers for 25 years.”

✅ REALITY

Yung Passenger Service Charges (PSC) or terminal fee of P200 for domestic and P550 for international have not changed since the year 2000 or for 25 years!

Oo mas mahal ang bagong rates (P390 domestic, P950 international),  pero mas mababa pa din ang fees ng NAIA compared sa Southeast Asia at pinantay lang yung fees sa NAIA with the airport fees sa Cebu, Clark, Davao, and Bohol (mga so-called international airports din).

Dumaan naman sa gobyerno at ADB yung adjusted fees so may technical studies yan ano ang appropriate fees.

❌ CLAIM

"The PPP was engineered to favor San Miguel Corp. and Ramon Ang."

✅ REALITY

In fairness, madami ibang concerns against San Miguel pero etong NNIC was the winning bidder out of four bids and sobrang layo ng bid ng NNIC sa iba kaya eto nanalo.

Other bidders like Ayala-Aboitiz-MVP group and GMR Consortium only offered 25 to 33% revenue share for the government. SOBRANG LAYO sa 82% na bid offer ng NNIC.

So it's a no-brainer na NNIC ang nanalong bid.

------

Busy na busy na ang ICI. Wag na natin dagdagan eto ng trabaho na hindi naman angkop or nararapat.

After reading the interim report released by ICI today, bumabalik ang credibility nya sakin.

Let's not get distracted.

Flood control and other infra lang please for the ICI.

#Accountability
#FloodControlProjects
